scoring.P45b: HALF CONFIRMED, HALF FALSIFIED — and the split refines the mechanism. Margin half CONFIRMED: mean (s_t - q_t) over chunks 100-500 is monotonically more negative with width (-0.1422 / -0.2057 / -0.2504) — wider models sit deeper below their own quantile. Slope half FALSIFIED as posed: the 100-500 slope ordering is d256 steeper than d512 (-0.000506 vs -0.000430), not strictly increasing with width. The refined mechanism: the wide model does its fast descent INSIDE the ignition phase (always-learn, chunks 0-100) — s3 at chunk 100 is already 5.639 for d512 vs 5.801/5.787 for d256/d128. The window then fills from the high descent trail, and fresh chunks sit persistently below its q75. The gate rate is born from the DEPTH of ignition descent, not from post-ignition slope.
